lines.en: My footsteps thud over the grass.
With a body like this, roads must yield.
Tusks point down; I walk with my head low.
The plains grass reaches my knees.
One stride clears half a path.
I walk slowly; nobody dares block me.
The soil packs down under me.

lines.zh: 鼻子甩来甩去，扫过草尖。
lines.en: My trunk swings, sweeping the grass tips.
The Paleogene plains are wide.
I walk carrying the herd's scent.
A row of deep prints trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我这体重，转身要久一点。
lines.en: At this weight, turning takes a while.
Will the riverbank hold me?
I shoulder a sapling aside.
My ears flap to drive off insects.

lines.zh: 这身皮厚，荆棘不算什么。
lines.en: Thick hide; thorns mean little.
I head along the treeline for water.

lines.zh: 走起来像一堵移动的坡。
lines.en: I move like a walking hillside.
I can sleep standing up.
My trunk curls up a tuft of grass.
Dust drifts in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子搭在自己的象牙上。
lines.en: I rest my trunk on my own tusk.
My ears fan twice, slowly.
Birds are calling far off.
When I stop, the grass goes quiet.
I scratch my flank with my trunk.
These tusks make my neck ache.
Wind arrives carrying water smell.
I'll just stand here a while.
Mud dries on my legs.
You barely reach my knee.
I lower my head to look at you.
I must bow my head to make you out.

lines.zh: 你手里那个小东西是什么？
lines.en: What is that little thing in your hand?
I don't mind you looking.
These tusks aren't decoration.
If you strike, I'll turn on you.
Firelight glints along my tusk.
Stand back so I can pass.

lines.zh: 平原上很少见到你这样的人。
lines.en: Few like you walk these plains.
The pain makes me give half a step.
Whoever's hiding with a bow, step out.
Thick hide, and it still shows a mark.
I shake my head and dust flies.
My foreleg dipped; I kept standing.
Blood drips down my tusk.
I rumble once and steady myself.
A deep wound; I'll remember.
Don't make me turn and charge.
I can still stand, still gore.
That clump of grass looks good.
Hold the tender branch a little higher.
My trunk already reached for it.
I don't eat meat; don't offer it.
That's not a mouthful for me.
Drop it in the grass; my trunk will find it.
Smells sweet; it's leaves.
I'll curl it up gently, no harm to you.
Step back once and I'll eat.
I can chew bark too.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，像只虫子碰上来。
lines.en: You hit me like a bug against a tree.
I barely felt that.
Save your strength; not enough.
I'll just step aside.
My tusk nudged you away.
The path is narrow; you go first.
Did the ground shake startle you?
I turn slower than you think.
Move; I'm headed for water.
Don't walk that close to my ear.
Just the two of us on this plain.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰碰你的脖子。
lines.en: I touch your neck with my trunk.
Let's walk together, slowly.
Your tusks are shorter than mine.
Enough grass here to last a year.
We must find water before the rains.
I'll walk at your flank.
No hurry; I can keep up.
Two of us and nothing dares try.
Walk beside me; I'll block the wind.
This branch is useful to me.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一卷就拿起来了。
lines.en: One curl of my trunk lifts it.
The fallen fruit is mine.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子卷块石头压住它。
lines.en: I roll a stone over it with my trunk.
This rock is just right for scratching.
A bundle of grass for later.
I'll carry it; no trouble.
Who left this wood here?
This leaf is too old.
I'll put it back where it was.
A patch of grass leans all one way.
I raise my head and turn that way.
I can see what you intend.
I'm guarding the calf behind me.
If I gore, I'll gore true.
Stay away from the herd.
Head low, tusks forward.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，这就是理由。
lines.en: You stood too close; that's reason enough.
I won't strike first, but I won't retreat.
Your steps are in the wind.

lines.zh: 我盯住那个会动的东西。
lines.en: I fix on the thing that moves.

lines.zh: 再往前，我就当你是威胁。
lines.en: One more step and you're a threat.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把象牙对着你。
lines.en: I turn to point my tusks at you.
I stamp twice as a warning.
My tail lashes, flattening grass.
Come closer and I charge.
My weight alone is a weapon.

lines.zh: 再走三步，我就没那么客气。
lines.en: Three more steps and I stop being polite.
The herd is behind me; don't cross.
I bellow, and the ground shakes.
I don't chase far; I hold ground.
Don't make any sudden move.
My ears are flared open.

lines.zh: 你绕圈，我一步就能截住。
lines.en: Circle all you like; one step cuts you off.
A broad swipe sends you stumbling back.
My tusk strikes your chest.

lines.zh: 被我这身重压一下试试。
lines.en: Try the weight of this body.
One forefoot stomp cracks the ground.
I strike with my head, not my teeth.
That one only pushed you away.
My trunk lashes like a whip.
Back off; I don't want a second blow.

lines.zh: 你听到了骨头的声音吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that bone?

lines.zh: 平原上我冲起来没人挡得住。
lines.en: On the plains nothing stops my charge.
I step out of the dust cloud.
What a wide plain.
The grass smells fresh.
First, I'll check the treeline.
This ground is firm enough.
Is anyone else of the herd here?
Sun warms my back.
I shake off the dust.

lines.zh: 这里能听见远处的水声。
lines.en: I can hear water far off.
Paleogene wind blows just like this.
I'll pick a spot and stand.
First, two mouthfuls of grass.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，皮都焦了。
lines.en: Fire scorched my back; the hide is singed.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，砸得很重。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and landed hard.

lines.zh: 水没到我头顶，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Water closed over my head; I kicked hard.

lines.zh: 炸得我站不稳，踉跄两步。
lines.en: The blast made me stagger two steps.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我肩上的皮。
lines.en: An arrow bit into the hide of my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那股力量在我骨头里响。
lines.en: That force hums inside my bones.
Too starved even to chew grass.

lines.zh: 雷劈在背上，我浑身一抖。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back; my whole body jolted.

lines.zh: 脚下的平原消失了，我往下坠。
lines.en: The plain vanished; I'm falling.
